description:
Duplicate an existing audit for a retest: pages, environments, RGAA results and example images are copied by Ara, with fresh IDs. The source audit is left untouched.

Ara's duplicate leaves part of the audit sheet empty (initiator, auditor organisation, procedure URL, contact, technologies, tools — verified against the live API). With copyMetadata (default true), this server then copies those fields from the source into the copy, keeping the pages in the source order. If that second step fails, the copy still exists: its IDs are returned with a warning.

copyMetadata.description: Copy the audit sheet fields Ara leaves empty (default true)

uniqueId.description: The editUniqueId of the audit to duplicate

name: duplicate_audit
title: Duplicate an audit
